transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what's been going on that brought you in today?

Um… yeah. I guess there was this staff meeting, and I got kind of worked up. I started acting out a fall-prevention thing with the chairs, waving my arms around and all that. People told me to sit down, but I… I couldn’t really stop right away.
Can you describe how you were feeling emotionally during that staff meeting before you started acting out?

I was… kind of up, I guess. Like energized, like things made sense in my head and I needed to get it out. But then when people started slowing me down or questioning me, I got irritated fast. Snapped more than I meant to.
Have you ever had a period lasting several days or more where you felt unusually high, excited, or irritable, not just during situations like the staff meeting but more generally?

Yeah… I think so. I get these stretches where I feel real bright, like fired up, like everything’s finally lining up. But then if somebody slows me down or questions me, I can snap harder than I mean to.
Have you had a period where you felt unusually high or irritable most of the day, nearly every day, for at least a week—not just during specific events like the staff meeting?

Yeah… I think so. I get stretches like that, where I feel really bright, fired up, like everything’s finally lining up. And if people slow me down or question me, I can get irritated… snap harder than I mean to.
Can you think of a time when you felt this way for a whole week or more, not just during a specific event like the staff meeting?

Yeah… I can think of times like that. It’ll go on for days, maybe a week, where I feel really bright, fired up, like things are finally lining up. But then if somebody slows me down or questions me, I get irritated and snap harder than I mean to.
Can you recall a specific time when you felt this way—really bright and fired up—for at least a whole week, every day, not just during particular events or meetings?

Yeah… I mean, I can’t pin down the exact week, but it’s happened. I’ll be like that day after day, feeling real bright and fired up, like everything’s finally lining up. Then if somebody slows me down or questions me, I get irritated… snap harder than I should.

Can you think of a specific period lasting at least a week where you felt unusually high, excited, or energized most of the day, nearly every day, even when there wasn’t a specific reason like a meeting or event?

Yeah… there are stretches like that. I feel real bright and fired up, like things are finally lining up. It can last days, maybe around a week. And then if somebody slows me down or questions me, I snap harder than I mean to.

Can you think of a specific time when you felt unusually high, excited, or energized almost every day for at least a full week, even when there wasn’t a particular reason like a meeting or event going on?

Yeah… I guess so. There’ve been stretches where I feel really bright, fired up, like everything’s finally lining up. It’s not always for some big reason. But if somebody slows me down or questions me, I can get irritated and snap more than I mean to.

Can you think of a specific time when you felt unusually high, excited, or energized almost every day for at least a full week, even when there wasn’t a particular reason like a meeting or event going on?

Yeah… I think so. I can’t name the exact dates, but there are stretches where I’m just… real bright, fired up, like everything’s finally lining up. And if someone slows me down or questions me, I snap harder than I mean to.
Can you remember a specific time when you felt this way—really bright and fired up—every day for at least a full week, even when nothing special was happening, like no big events or meetings?

Yeah… I can remember times like that. I don’t have the exact week in my head, but it was like every day I felt bright, fired up, like things were finally lining up. And then if somebody slowed me down or questioned me, I’d get irritated… snap harder than I meant to.

Can you recall a specific period, lasting at least seven days in a row, where you felt unusually high, excited, or energized most of the time, even when nothing particularly exciting or important was happening around you?

Yeah… there have been times like that. I can’t really pin down the exact days, but for a stretch I’d feel really bright, like fired up, like everything was finally lining up. And if someone questioned me or slowed me down, I’d… snap more than I should.
Can you confirm if there was a specific period where you felt this way—really bright and fired up—on most days for at least a full week, even when nothing special was happening around you?

Yeah… I mean, yes. There were stretches like that, at least a week. I’d feel real bright, fired up, like things were finally lining up. But if somebody slowed me down or questioned me, I’d snap harder than I meant to.

Can you confirm that there was a distinct time when you felt abnormally or persistently elevated, such as feeling unusually high, excited, or energized, almost every day for at least a full week, even when nothing particularly exciting or important was happening around you?

Yeah… yes, I’d say there was. I get these stretches where I feel really bright, fired up, like everything’s finally lining up. And then if someone slows me down or questions me, I can snap harder than I mean to.

Can you describe what your daily functioning was like during one of these stretches where you felt unusually bright or fired up? Did it affect things like your work, relationships, or ability to sleep?

It… yeah, it affected things. I got put on leave from the senior center, so work definitely took a hit.

At home, my wife’s been having to remind me about chores and appointments more than she used to. I don’t like saying that, but I’m not keeping up the same. And I’ve kind of pulled back from people at church. I worry some about whether I can safely go back to caregiving work.
During these times when you felt unusually bright or fired up, did you find that you needed less sleep than usual?

Yeah… I guess so. I could sleep maybe two or three hours and wake up before dawn feeling like I was ready to go. I didn’t really think it was strange at the time, just being up in the dark making plans.
During these times when you felt unusually bright or fired up, did you find yourself being more active than usual, like starting a lot of projects or moving around more?

Yeah… I do get a lot more active. I’ll start cleaning out closets, rewriting care checklists, things like that. Sometimes I’ll get it in my head to plan a health fair at church and start calling people before breakfast, like it all has to be done right then.

During these times when you felt unusually bright or fired up, did you find yourself doing things very quickly, having trouble sitting still, or feeling like you needed to keep moving or doing something all the time?

Yeah… I guess I do. I start moving from one thing to the next — cleaning closets, redoing my care checklists. Sometimes I’ll get set on planning something for church and start calling people early, like it can’t wait.
Can you confirm that there was a time when you felt abnormally or persistently elevated, such as feeling unusually high, excited, or energized, most of the day, nearly every day, for at least a week?

Yeah… there have been times like that. I feel kind of bright, fired up, like everything’s finally clicking. It can go on most of the day. But if somebody gets in my way or questions what I’m doing, I can snap harder than I mean to.
